newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Eltin says miner dies at Big Bell gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Eltin says miner dies at Big Bell gold mine.

text.p: Mining contractor Eltin Ltd said on Friday one of its employees died on Thursday while working underground at the Big Bell gold mine in Western Australia.

Eltin said Peter David Tyler, 42, who had 20 years experience working in underground mines, was struck by a rack which peeled off the work face. He subsequently died of injuries incurred in the accident.
Police attended the incident as soon as they were notified. Inspectors from the Department of Minerals and Energy are currently at Big Bell conducting an investigation into the accident, it said.

Eltin said its management and safety specialists together with the manager of the Big Bell mine, Normandy Mining Ltd /St Barbara Mines Ltd joint venture, are also conducting an investigation into the cause of the accident.
